look.why: Bamboo green: a calm pastel lime that lets the black-and-white coat pop and says 'dinner' at the same time; a hex (the pastel of lime-400) because every Tailwind lime or green pastel sits too close to the white fur (delta E under 30).

habitat.text: Cool, misty mountain forests full of bamboo in central China, 1,200 to 3,900 m up.

diet.text: Bamboo, bamboo, bamboo! It munches 10 to 12 hours a day, with the odd fish or insect.

facts.text: That 'thumb' isn't a finger. It's a pad over a wrist bone, perfect for gripping bamboo.
A newborn panda weighs just 85 to 140 g. That's lighter than an apple!
